description: An XML body whose pact names no namespace, answered by a root element in one. pact-specification's v3 and v4 case `unexpected xml namespace` says it matches, and pact-reference's V2 engine agrees; today's verifier, and pact-jvm, compare the qualified name and fail it. Janus follows the specification: a deliberate difference in the ledger (ADR 0039 decision 4)
source: staged plan S1.22; pact-specification's testcases/v3/response/body/unexpected xml namespace.json, which pact_matching's own spec tests ignore as "Incorrect behaviour - fixed in V2 engine"; ADR 0039
